high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "ananyapanday," who is located in Milan, Italy. The post features a nighttime scene of the iconic Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano) illuminated with lights, showcasing its intricate Gothic architecture. The cathedral's spires and detailed carvings are prominently visible, and scaffolding can be seen on some parts of the structure, indicating ongoing restoration or maintenance work. In the foreground, there is a person standing on a balcony or terrace, leaning against the railing.
